conditions.notes: ASM-0002 assumes pull requests can serve as candidate changes and review-and-merge as the acceptance map. OBS-0021 does not dispute that they can; it observes that in this repository nothing mechanical checks that the merging party differs from the proposing one. The assumption is load-bearing for FIELD.md sections 5 to 7 and is currently discharged by a GitHub setting outside the audited tree. Holds under the condition that branch protection is not configured to require an independent approver; if it is, the condition is met but still not visible in the record.
